components.write_rule: compare-and-set by event_ts on both the in-process TTL cache and Redis
components.read_rule: cache before database; a cached value is never older than its event_ts
components.conflict_rule: an older event_ts is rejected (last-writer-wins is disallowed)
components.staleness_rule: TTL expiry plus event_ts monotonicity; no resurrection of an older value
components.concurrency_guard: in-process CAS in _TTLCache.set + Redis Lua CAS on a companion :ets key

components.write_rule: validate_order reserves pending atomically; register_fill converts; caps checked against actual+pending
components.conflict_rule: reservation-lag bypass closed: a second order sees the first's pending hold
components.staleness_rule: reservations discharged on reject/cancel/timeout; open_reservation_count leak detector

components.write_rule: each subscribe appends a tracked asyncio.Task to _consumer_tasks[topic]
components.read_rule: tasks are enumerated only from the owning event loop
components.conflict_rule: duplicate topic subscriptions track distinct tasks; none is orphaned
components.staleness_rule: stop() cancels every tracked task, awaits cancellation, then clears the map
components.concurrency_guard: single asyncio event loop confinement + explicit task tracking and cancel-on-stop

components.write_rule: append under the lock; each event links prev_hash to form a hash chain
components.read_rule: snapshot/replay read the chain under the lock
components.conflict_rule: sequence is strictly monotonic; a broken prev_hash link is rejected
components.staleness_rule: append-only; no in-place mutation, so no stale overwrite is possible

components.write_rule: keys are derived by pure canonicalization; the factory holds only an immutable namespace UUID
components.read_rule: build() is a pure function of its inputs
components.conflict_rule: canonicalization is deterministic (float -0.0->0.0, sorted keys) so equal payloads map to equal keys
components.staleness_rule: no mutable runtime state; nothing can go stale

components.write_rule: engine creation and monitor registration mutate shared state under the lock
components.read_rule: session() acquires the lock to read the engine handle
components.conflict_rule: single engine instance; concurrent initialisation is serialised
components.staleness_rule: engine is created once and reused; disposal is explicit

components.write_rule: each operation runs inside a SessionManager-scoped transaction with retry
components.read_rule: reads run in a read_only session scope
components.conflict_rule: transactional isolation is delegated to the database/session
components.staleness_rule: no local cache; every read hits the session
components.concurrency_guard: stateless (holds no mutable state; delegates to SessionManager's lock and DB transactions)

components.write_rule: each tick updates _data_history/_last_updates/_rolling_stats for its symbol
components.read_rule: health reads the latest rolling stats per symbol
components.conflict_rule: per-symbol last_update_ts orders updates; older ticks do not advance state
components.staleness_rule: rolling window bounds history; a symbol with no recent update is flagged degraded
components.concurrency_guard: single-writer (monitor is confined to one ingest thread; not shared across threads)

components.write_rule: task registration and status transitions mutate _tasks under the lock
components.conflict_rule: duplicate task_id registration is rejected deterministically under the lock
components.staleness_rule: terminal tasks are pruned; status transitions are guarded
components.concurrency_guard: threading.Lock (_lock) around task registration and status transitions
